signals.title: Teams struggle to govern AI coding agent workflows
signals.summary: Engineering teams report growing pain in the coding agent approval workflow when reviewing and auditing changes across repositories.

signals.title: Request: one approval trail for coding agent changes
signals.summary: A popular developer tool issue requests one coding agent approval workflow for plans, diffs, tests, and rollbacks across repositories.

signals.title: Coding agent governance is becoming a workflow bottleneck
signals.summary: Developers describe recurring friction in the coding agent approval workflow, including failed checks and rollback decisions across separate tools.

signals.title: Local-first test environments remain painful for service teams
signals.summary: Service developers report recurring pain and want disposable local test environment automation for production dependencies.

signals.title: Automate disposable local test environments
signals.summary: Maintainers request disposable local test environment automation built from service manifests without custom setup scripts.

signals.title: Disposable local test environments move into developer platforms
signals.summary: Developer platform teams are adopting disposable local test environment automation to reduce setup pain and integration drift.
